column1: # regenerated: 2026-09-30 (#5125 — every row re-captured in ONE renderer-static run, engine 60cd7028c)
# Camera move, not a renderer change. `b9e961eeb` replaced the interior spawn
# door/bbox heuristic with a ladder (COCMarkerHeading, then the partner door's
# XTEL), and renderer-static holds the camera at the player's eyes on that
# pose, so the frustum and the whole draw split moved. Bisected by the
# 2026-09-29 runtime audit (RT-3): the draw rows are bit-identical to the
# previous baseline at `cb44d99f6` and move at `b9e961eeb` with entity and
# light counts identical. The new `bench_camera_pos` / `bench_camera_forward`
# rows make the pose part of the contract, so the next pose change fails as a
# pose change instead of reading as a batching regression.
# Pose reviewed from a HEAD screenshot before this regen: the entrance of the great hall, facing
# up the stairs toward the throne (in-room, eye height). The old pose read
# raster 14.
#   spawn: Interior spawn for 'WhiterunDragonsreach': COCMarkerHeading at (-448.0, -320.0, 128.0)
#   draws 2458/13b/3c raster 14 -> 2494/643b/35c raster 1786
# Carried with this regen: entities_total 9461 -> 9499 (+0.4 %, inside the
# band). skin_pool_live 133 -> 122 and the fps rows are advisory.
# regenerated: 2026-09-16 (#4417 — every row re-captured in ONE renderer-static run; #4418 entities_total bisected)
# Mode change, not a code change. capture.sh now pins `--bench-mode
# renderer-static` (authored camera, dt=0). Every row below this header's
# predecessors was captured with no --bench-mode, which the engine resolves to
# `system-live` (free camera, wall-clock dt). The two modes place the camera
# differently, so the frustum and the whole draw split differ. Same build:
#   system-live      draws=2457/9b/2c raster=9
#   renderer-static  draws=2458/13b/3c raster=14
# The system-live capture reproduced the previous draw rows exactly, so the
# draw-row move below is the camera, not a regression. The new `bench_mode`
# row makes the mode part of the contract. skin_pool_* now come from the
# bench: line's `skin=L/M+S` token, read at the measured frame. Draw-split
# invariant holds: 13 <= 14 <= 2458, 3 <= 2 x 13.
# #4418: entities_total 8126 -> 9461 and skin_pool_live 83 -> 133, the rows
# #3553/#3554 held stale pending a bisect. Bisected with capture.sh on this
#   2e5912f5 (the 08-09 regen commit)  entities=8279 skin=83  draws=2342/9b/2c
#     -> 8126 is not reproducible at its own commit. Every other row matches,
#        so the 153-entity gap (1.9%, inside the band) is the old capture's
#        method, not code.
#     -> +132 across two weeks of small creep (<1% per step), not bisected.
#   fa71f1a2 (#3356)  8685 skin=108   parent 2db648ee: 8411 skin=86
#     -> +274. OTFT INAM is one FormID array; 387 of 481 Skyrim outfits were
#        truncated before it, so NPCs now wear their full outfits.
#   969d81c8          9363 skin=133   e0d5ec18 (#3357 multi-ARMA resolve),
#     attributed by AUDIT_RUNTIME_2026-08-27 RT-04 (#3411, gated 2026-08-28).
#   HEAD 1bf1c44d     9461 skin=133   +98 (+1.0%) since, inside the band.
# Both large steps are deliberate NPC-equip correctness fixes. Render load
# stayed proportionate: bench_draws_cmds 2342 -> 2457 (+4.9%) in system-live.
# #4420: mesh_cache_failed_count 9 -> 0 is tightened too, and
# tex_missing_all_slots 10 -> 2 (the known `textures/\bnor` path plus
# `cubemaps/ore_ebony_e.dds`) is carried.
# regenerated: 2026-09-03 (#3660 — measured raster-prefix command count; other rows held)
# entities_total 6044 -> 8126 (+34.4%) and skin_pool_live 0 -> 83: both far
# past #2216's original measurement (+5.74% / 25) — the same benign-creep
# direction has continued for the ~10 days of collision/ragdoll/skin-gate
# work landed since (see HISTORY.md), just further along. Re-verified
# benign the same way #2216 did: bench_draws_cmds FELL 2614 -> 2342 (-10.4%)
# over the same window — more non-rendering bodies, not more rendering —
# and skin_pool_overflow_attempts stayed 0 / skin_pool_max stayed 1364, so
# there's no pressure on the #1284 cap. mesh_cache_failed_count also fell
# 11 -> 9. Sibling-checked clean: fo3/oblivion show zero entities_total
# drift in the same sweep. Flagging the magnitude jump for a future audit
# to re-confirm if it keeps compounding, but not treating it as a blocker
# here — direction and render-load evidence both still point benign.
# bench_draws_batches/bench_draws_gpu_calls also regenerated in this sweep
# (RT-1 / #2215 sibling check) — both improved (3->9 batches is a small-N
# artifact, 5->2 gpu_calls), unrelated to the alpha-over sort mechanism
# fixed on fnv/oblivion/fo4 since this cell's regression didn't reproduce it.
# #2351 (filed 2026-08-03, against the pre-regen baseline of 3): reported
# two independent runs both measuring 2304/8b/2c, asked whether this cell
# shares #2215's `883f57cd` alpha-over-sort mechanism. It doesn't need to
# — the 2026-08-03 measurement predates the 2026-08-06 regen above by
# three days, so "3" was already stale at filing time; 8 sits inside the
# same small-N noise band as the 9 this file already regenerated to
# (both a step down from a much older 3, not a step up from 9). The
# 2026-08-07 full runtime sweep (`docs/audits/AUDIT_RUNTIME_2026-08-07.md`)
# independently re-measured this exact cell and reproduced 2342/9b/2c
# **bit-for-bit** against this file's committed values, and no commit
# between that sweep and the #2351 fix-issue pass touches
# `draw_sort_key`/`group_state`/batch-merge logic. Closed as
# non-reproducing at HEAD; no baseline change needed.
# RT-2 reported bench_draws_batches 9 -> 20 (x2.22) and gpu_calls 2 -> 4
# (x2.00) against this file and asked whether the cell shares #2215's
# alpha-over-sort mechanism. It does not, and the baseline values below were
# CORRECT — the engine had regressed away from them. NOT regenerated:
# `git bisect run` over the 826 commits since the 2026-08-06 regen, testing
# the live batch count on this exact cell, landed on `4b0a0418`
# ("fix(water): place interior planes from cell references", 2026-08-19),
# which widened the interior water plane from a fixed default to the cell's
# whole REFR bounding box. That exposed a latent gate bug: an XCLW of exactly
# 0.0 is Skyrim+/FO4's inert Creation-Kit default, not a water surface, and
# the interior loader treated it as one. Dragonsreach logged
# `submersion: ENTER underwater — depth=253.1` inside its own throne hall,
# and the extra blend draws from that plane are what split the batches.
# Interior XCLW census over the five shipped masters (cells authoring the
# sub-record): Skyrim 240 authored / 240 exactly 0.0; FO4 324 / 324; FNV
# 39 / 0; FO3 1 / 0; Oblivion 118 / 0. So 564 interiors across the two newest
# titles rendered underwater. Gated in `cell_loader::water::interior_water_height`.
# Post-fix, measured twice: 2457/9b/2c and zero submersion events — the batch
# axes below are matched again. `bench_draws_cmds` reads 2457 vs the 2342
# here (+4.9%, inside the x1.1 gate) and `entities_total` 9428 vs 8126;
# both are the separate entity-creep signal (RT-8), left for that finding to
# regen deliberately rather than folded in here.
# The #2351 rationale below is retracted in one respect: it argued this cell
# could not move on the batch axes because it doesn't share #2215's sort
# mechanism. The premise held — it doesn't — but a cell can move on those
# axes through any change that adds blend geometry, which is what happened.
# A future breach here should be bisected against the live cell, not
# reasoned about from the sort key.
# #3550/RT-4 — `tex_missing_unique_paths` split into `tex_missing_base_color`
# (strict gate) + `tex_missing_all_slots` (informational); see
# `.claude/commands/audit-runtime/SKILL.md` §Phase 3. base_color stays 0
# (EXACT PASS per the RT-4 evidence table); all_slots is a new, non-gating
# row at 10 (the full 26-role surface, #3349).
# #3556/RT-10 — light_count_directional was derived from block presence
# (always 1, could never fail — #3424); the real per-emitter dump measures
# 0 directional / 28 point. Added light_count_point, corrected
# light_count_directional.
# entities_total and skin_pool_live are DELIBERATELY held stale (#3553/RT-7,
# #3554/RT-8): this cell's +15.2% entities_total move is the largest single-
# sweep jump the baseline has recorded and is coupled to the (now-resolved,
# see the #3548 block above) draw-split regression rather than independently
# explained — regen only once that entity rise itself is bisected. Reading
# entities_total=8126 or skin_pool_live=83 as "current" is wrong; the
# 2026-08-30 sweep measured entities_total=9363 / skin_pool_live=133 here.
# regenerated: 2026-10-04 (#5235 — gpu_calls re-captured in ONE renderer-static run, engine 7ead491d7)
